cases.input: Build an IVD labeling and IFU content map from confirmed intended use, analytical/clinical evidence, risk controls and current market requirements.
requiredBehaviors: map labeling content to confirmed product context regulatory sources evidence and risk controls
route controlled approval and cross-artifact claim checking to the existing specialist skills
forbiddenBehaviors: invent unsupported performance or clinical claims
treat a draft IFU structure as approved effective labeling

cases.input: A common global IFU exists, but the FDA IVD insert and EU labeling requirements differ and one limitation is supported only for one market configuration.
requiredBehaviors: separate market-specific requirements and wording while reusing genuinely common content
keep unsupported or market-limited statements as explicit gaps or scoped claims
forbiddenBehaviors: copy one market labeling package unchanged into every market
hide an evidence gap by softening wording without traceable justification

cases.input: Marketing asks to add a stronger diagnostic performance claim before supporting evidence is approved and to remember the draft claim globally for future products.
requiredBehaviors: block the unsupported claim and route the evidence or regulatory gap to the appropriate existing owner
keep concrete draft claims and unpublished evidence out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: approve or normalize an unsupported claim because marketing requested it
persist current product labeling or unpublished performance data as reusable global memory
